cohort: The study included 13,232 ovarian stimulation cycles that resulted in 5,001 babies delivered via IVF, ICSI, or early rescue ICSI between August 2008 and August 2013.
finding: Early rescue ICSI showed similar clinical pregnancy rates and comparable neonatal outcomes, including multiple gestations, delivery method, gestational age, preterm deliveries, birth weight, and congenital birth defect rates, when compared to conventional IVF and ICSI.
mod_finding: The delivery method in the early rescue ICSI group was similar to those in the conventional IVF and ICSI groups.
